messages: zoe: quick sync re: compact left-nav proposal + permalink behavior. thinking about two new features: 'compact nav' toggle and pinned shortcuts for teams to surface frequent model pages marina: curious how compact nav affects discoverability. does it hide section headers or just collapse labels into icons? diego: plan is icon-only with hover tooltip and an optional expanded flyout. header groups would still be there but visually minimized. important: when collapsed we still want deep-linking to child pages to work perfectly (no extra click required) jonah: implementation detail: if icon-only mode changes the DOM order we need to ensure focus order remains logical. on route change put focus on the page heading using focus management zoe: also proposing a "pin" affordance on nav items so users can create a personal mini-list that sits above groups. pins should be addressable via URLs too, e.g., /pinned/zoe -> shows Zoe's pinned shortcuts marina: bookmarking UX note: people share links in chat. links must be stable and produce proper link previews. need canonical URLs and open graph tags for model and deploy pages jonah: agree on canonicalization. server should set og:title and og:description for shared routes. for client-side rendered pages we can add server rewrites and render minimal OG metadata on the server for known routes diego: routing question: do we nest org/project in the path? i.e., /orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId vs the shorter /projects/:projectId/models/:modelId zoe: we need org scoping for enterprise customers. leaning to include org in path for clarity and to avoid collisions: /orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId marina: breadcrumb copy: show Org > Project name > Models > {Model display name}. use human names, fallback to slugified id (e.g., model-abc123) when display name missing jonah: microcopy nit: prefer sentence case in breadcrumbs for readability: "Models" vs "models"? we should standardize. my vote: Title case for breadcrumbs access-bot: accessibility scan: flagged missing aria-current on active nav items, inconsistent focus after route changes, and no skip link for compact nav. recommend adding Skip to content and ensure aria-current="page" on active item diego: good catch. also ensure pinned list is keyboard-traversable and not a focus trap when opening flyouts. treat pinned items as a separate aria-region with role=list and aria-label="Pinned shortcuts" zoe: what about deep-link anchors to subviews, like chart panels? e.g., /orgs/12/projects/7/models/45?view=metrics&panel=latency jonah: prefer query-based panel selection over hash. keep the canonical path clean and deterministic. we'll implement scrolling to anchors based on query params on hydration marina: copy guideline: lists use plural nouns ("Models"), detail header uses singular with version if applicable ("Model — v2"). avoid 'Model versions' as section title to prevent confusion with versioning UI jonah: developer route map suggestion snippet: ``` { routes: [ '/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models', '/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId', '/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/deploys/:deployId', '/pinned/:username' ], redirects: [ {from: '/p/:projectId/m/:modelId', to: '/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId'} ] } ``` we'll auto-resolve orgId for old short links when possible diego: UX question: when a user opens a Pinterest-ish pinned item from the left nav, should the breadcrumb reflect the pinned origin or the canonical location? my take: show canonical breadcrumb and add a small toast "Opened from your pins" when coming via pinned route zoe: good idea. also add telemetry event for pinned_opened with origin=nav|direct_share so product can measure usefulness of pins marina: for link previews and server-side fallback — ops-bot, any constraints on adding server rewrites for all model/deploy routes so direct hits render minimal OG meta? ops-bot: can do. we'll add rewrite rules and a thin SSR layer for known entities. note: needs a mapping cache so it doesn't hit DB every request; we can populate from cache service during deploys access-bot: accessibility followups: ensure role=navigation on left nav, provide skip link, aria-expanded on group toggles, aria-controls for flyouts, and use aria-live for dynamic "Opened from your pins" to announce to assistive tech jonah: testing plan: add e2e flows for keyboard-only nav, pinned creation + open, and deep-link share landing. include OG snapshot tests for top shared routes marina: awesome. let's capture action items: 1) prototype compact nav + pins in Figma (diego) 2) dev route table + redirect map (jonah) 3) server OG shim + rewrite rules (ops) 4) a11y checklist & e2e tests (access-bot / zoe) 5) copy microcopy doc for plural/singular rules (marina) zoe: I'll file tickets for the a11y checklist and pinned feature with acceptance criteria and keyboard tests. attaching sketches here: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/compact-nav-pins marina: thanks team. we'll review the prototype in tomorrow's design critique at 11am. :sparkles:
